			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_threshing_machine }  any_country = { has_technology_researched = threshing_machine  NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism } } }
			set_global_variable = pmr_held_threshing_machine
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_vacuum_canning }  any_country = { has_technology_researched = vacuum_canning  NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism } } }
			set_global_variable = pmr_held_vacuum_canning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_vulcanization }  any_country = { has_technology_researched = vulcanization  NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism } } }
			set_global_variable = pmr_held_vulcanization
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_watertube_boiler }  any_country = { has_technology_researched = watertube_boiler  NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism } } }
			set_global_variable = pmr_held_watertube_boiler
		}
	}
}
